content: ClientServerOperation A ClientServerOperation consists of 0..* ArgumentDataPrototype s. The latter may be • passed to the operation (i.e. the direction is “in”) • passed to and returned from the operation (i.e. the direction is “inout”) • returned from the operation (i.e. the direction is “out”) The aggregation represents a variation point.
